logp.method_description: LogPow were carried out using the shake flask method.19 PtIV compounds were dissolved in 0.9 % w/v NaCl in ultrapure water (pre-saturated with n-octanol for 96 h and left to stand overnight). The solutions were sonicated and filtered through Celite to remove undissolved PtIV compounds. The initial Pt concentrations were determined by ICP-OES to ascertain the maximum solubility of the complexes. Subsequently, these solutions were added to an equal volume of n-octanol (pre-saturated with 0.9 % w/v NaCl in ultrapure water for 96 h and left to stand overnight) and shaken vigorously for 2 h before centrifuging at 4200 g for 15 min to achieve phase separation. The residual Pt concentrations in the aqueous phase were determined by ICP-OES from which the LogPow was calculated. All experiments were done in triplicate.
